summary.title: Michael Herman
summary.one_liner: This is an archive index of Michael Herman's blog posts from 2012 to 2020, mostly on Node.js, Angular, Docker, Kubernetes, and web scraping, useful for finding a specific tutorial by topic.
takeaways: Browse a chronological list of blog post titles from 2012 to 2020
Find tutorials on Node.js, Express, Koa, and Passport authentication
Find tutorials on Docker, Kubernetes, and deploying apps with GitLab CI
Find older posts on web scraping with Scrapy and regular expressions
summary.summary: This page is the archive listing for Michael Herman's blog, showing post titles grouped by year from 2012 through 2020. It contains no article body, so the content is only the titles. The posts cover Node.js and Express APIs, authentication with Passport and Token-based methods, Angular, Docker and Kubernetes deployment, testing with Sinon and TestCafe, and earlier topics like web2py, Django, Excel analytics, and Scrapy. Use it as a topic finder to locate specific posts.
